_doc: Source of truth for every sound effect and music bed in Out of Ruin.
`node tools/audio/generate.mjs` calls Scenario's ElevenLabs SFX v2 and ElevenLabs Music APIs and downloads raw MP3s + .meta sidecars to `tools/audio/source/`.

`node tools/audio/bake.mjs` strips leading silence (with transient alignment on taps/UI), trims to natural decay, normalises loudness, bakes seamless loop seams on music, and writes AAC-LC (.m4a) + .meta sidecars to `game/audio/{sfx,music}/`.
All tonal cues and music beds are composed in D major / D Dorian so gameplay cascades and music fuse harmonically.
